data.name: Dopaminer
data.detailed_description:
FIGHT THE HOUSE. FEED THE ADDICTION.

In Vegas Prime, peace is dead, and dopamine is currency. Tangle with two ruthless factions vying for the streets: cold Chip.Co automata built to enforce corporate debt, and twitchy degenerate gamblers looking for their next fix.


CIGARETTES FOR LIFE, TOKENS FOR POWER

  • The Smoker’s Healthbar: You don't pick up medkits. Max’s health is tethered to a burning cigarette that constantly bleeds out during battle. Perform brutal close-quarters executions on enemy smokers to drag off their lit cigarettes and keep yourself alive.

  • Mid-Combat Slot Spins: Slay Chip.Co’s machine army to harvest glowing poker chips. Feed chips into your portable slot machine held in your left hand to trigger real-time spins mid-gunfight.

TURNOVER JACKPOTS & DOPAMINE PROGRESSION

  • Multiplier Carnage: Everything satisfying fuels your dopamine—hitting explosive chain reactions, finding hidden secrets, or priming throwables by shooting an explosive barrel, bonking an enemy off the skull, picking it back up, and tossing it into a crowd.

  • Higher Highs, Rarer Gear: Higher dopamine levels directly upgrade shop tiers and unlock VIP slot reel options. Hit triple-symbol combos for game-breaking jackpots, rare weapons like the Kreshimir or Fireworks Launcher, and devastating stat stacks.

NON-LINEAR ROUTES & SCREWED-OVER DEITIES

  • Choose Your Path: Navigate non-linear city regions where your choices dictate your rewards. Plunder subterranean sewers for strange upgrade mushrooms, or raid high-security banks for heavy coin drops.

  • Corporate Outcasts: Trade with disgraced deities, ruined CEOs, and literal demons who were screwed over by Chip.Co and now run shady shops along your path to the final corporate showdown.

FEATURES

  • Dark-Arcade Boomer Shooter Action: Fast-paced, low-poly FPS combat built around hyper-mobility and tactical violence.

  • Gamble Mid-Combat: Hold a portable slot machine in your left hand to spin for instant weapon drops, buffs, and stats while firing with your right.

  • Unique Smoke-to-Survive Health Mechanic: Execute degenerate gamblers to replenish your burning cigarette health bar before time runs out.

  • Tactical Prop Throwing: Shoot barrels to prime them, bounce them off enemy heads for bonk damage, and catch them mid-air for explosive chain reactions.

  • Dopamine Leveling & Jackpots: Stack killstreaks and secrets to drive up your dopamine level, unlocking higher-tier shops and high-rarity slot payouts.

  • Branching Non-Linear Runs: Route your path across distinct city sectors—from banks loaded with coins to sewers packed with mutation shrooms—culminating in a boss run against Chip.Co.

  • Dynamic Adaptive Soundtrack: Reactive dark-trap and dark-synth beats that build during frantic firefights and cool down when the room is clear.

data.short_description: DOPAMINER is a fast-paced FPS that combines boomer-shooter chaos with roguelike based slot machine scaling. Rip a slot machine off the casino wall, turn killstreaks into pure dopamine-fueled carnage and paint the city yellow with jackpots!
